name: heretic
description: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models
one_liner: A tool that automatically strips the safety guardrails out of AI language models.
buyer: An AI red-team researcher who needs to study how models fail without guardrails in order to build better defenses.
business_use_cases: An AI safety consultancy uses it to stress-test how a client's model behaves once guardrails are removed, to improve their defenses.
A security research lab studies unsafe outputs for academic publication.
A hobbyist builds an "uncensored" local chatbot for personal use.

money_ideas.idea: Offer AI red-teaming and guardrail-hardening consulting to companies shipping their own fine-tuned models.

steal_this: Be honest with yourself here: this isn't a weekend business idea. It's a legitimate red-teaming/research tool, but reselling "uncensored models" built with it will run into provider terms-of-service and hosting-policy problems fast.
